name: Skimetric
description:
Skimetric gives agents verified European ski data and a full trip-planning pipeline. Forecasts come from our own multi-model system (ECMWF, ICON, MeteoSwiss and other European providers) run on our own EU servers and verified daily against ~2,800 mountain weather stations — the scoreboard is public at skimetric.eu/accuracy. Live lift and piste status comes only from authorized sources and fails closed: unverified is reported as unverified, never guessed. Coverage: 1,577 resorts in 28 countries, with ten years of snow history per elevation band, trip costs, webcams, resort imagery, and a self-hosted routing engine that answers "which airport, and how long to the village" with real road and rail times.

Beyond data, plan_trip runs our AI trip researcher end to end: it compares resorts against the brief, prices the full journey (flights, transfers, lodging, gear), returns options with a PDF report and summary, and supports a real conversation loop (tell_skym / skym_says). Trips are created on anonymous guest identities — no PII flows through the connector; the human claims the trip via a link. Everything bookable is an attributed skimetric.eu entry link — the affiliate model that keeps the service free is disclosed in the contract at skimetric.eu/mcp. Free, no account, no API key.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Skimetric to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Skimetric to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://skimetric.eu/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Skimetric MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Skimetric scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Skimetric MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Skimetric lists 16 MCP tools, including booking_options, choose_path, conditions, daily_snow, find_resorts, getting_there, open_booking, plan_trip, resort_media, season_history, snow_forecast, and tell_skym.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Skimetric?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Skimetric in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and TiCATi.
Skimetric does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Skimetric is developed by Skimetric. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
